verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a RESTful API with JWT AccessKey/SecretKey auth, regional endpoints, and an MCP/CLI offering. It never mentions an official SDK in any language. A raw REST API is a developer building block and MCP/CLI is an adjacent feature, so neither counts toward official SDKs. Third-party API providers (fal.ai, WaveSpeedAI, etc.) are not first-party SDKs either.
